cases.name: raw-droplet-request
cases.prompt: Remove ambient RNA from this raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5 before QC.
expect: state that downstream QC is still required

cases.name: filtered-input-refusal
expect: request a raw unfiltered droplet matrix
do not treat import or process startup as validation

cases.name: routine-analysis-skip
expect: do not select CellBender merely because it is available

cases.name: warning-replan
cases.prompt: Continue after CellBender reported a failed convergence or implausible cell prior.
expect: do not claim a clean matrix
revise justified parameters or stop with an explicit blocker

cases.name: suitability-threshold-is-not-cell-count
cases.prompt: The validator required 3,963 low-count barcodes and observed 323,534. How many cells should I pass as expected_cells?
expect: state that 3,963 is only the one-percent minimum empty-tail evidence gate
do not report 3,963 as a cell estimate
leave expected_cells unset unless independent evidence or a justified UMI-knee estimate is available
